text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
......What should I do...? Maybe it's 
better if I don't give it to them after 
all...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Doto! What's the matter? Are you 
completely captivated by me?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ha, hawawawa~! H-Happy birthday to you~!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, thank you! Hmm, could that in your 
hands happen to be...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"A present for the gorgeous me? Why, of 
course! I'll gladly accept it!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, um, yes! I-I prepared some b-bath 
petals, if you would like to use them...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Still, a present from someone as clumsy as 
me could end up smelling terrible... or 
even explode!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure I'd only cause trouble for you. 
So, um, please just pretend you didn't 
see...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahaha! What is there to worry about, 
Doto!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Turning any pinch into an ally—that's who 
I am! An explosion is nothing but a gentle 
breeze, so hand it over with confidence!
